# Global statistics file
######################################################
# The quantities are all given in internal units!
#
# (0)  Simulation step
#      Unit = dimensionless
# (1)  Time since Big Bang (cosmological run), Time since start of the simulation (non-cosmological run).
#      Unit = 1.000000e+00 s
#      Unit = 3.168877e-08 yr 
#      Unit = 3.168877e-14 Myr 
# (2)  Scale factor
#      Unit = dimensionless
# (3)  Redshift
#      Unit = dimensionless
# (4)  Total mass in the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (5)  Total gas mass in the simulation (Particle type 0). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (6)  Total dark matter mass in the simulation (Particle type 1 & 2). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (7)  Total sink mass in the simulation (Particle type 3). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (8)  Total stellar mass in the simulation (Particle type 4). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (9)  Total black hole mass in the simulation (Particle type 5). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (10) Total metal mass in the gas phase. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (11) Total metal mass locked in stars. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (12) Total metal mass locked in black holes. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (13) Total kinetic energy (physical). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg
# (14) Total internal (thermal) energy of the gas (physical). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg
# (15) Total potential energy (physical). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg
# (16) Total radiated energy of the gas (physical). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg
# (17) Total gas entropy (physical). 
#      Unit = 1.000002e+41 gram**(0.333) * cm**(4.000) * s**(-2.000)
# (18) Comoving centre of mass of the simulation (x coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+08 cm
#      Unit = 3.240779e-11 pc
#      Unit = 3.240779e-17 Mpc
# (19) Comoving centre of mass of the simulation (y coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+08 cm
#      Unit = 3.240779e-11 pc
#      Unit = 3.240779e-17 Mpc
# (20) Comoving centre of mass of the simulation (z coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+08 cm
#      Unit = 3.240779e-11 pc
#      Unit = 3.240779e-17 Mpc
# (21) Comoving momentum of the simulation (x coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+35 gram * cm * s**-1
# (22) Comoving momentum of the simulation (y coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+35 gram * cm * s**-1
# (23) Comoving momentum of the simulation (z coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+35 gram * cm * s**-1
# (24) Comoving angular momentum of the simulation (x coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 gram * cm**2 * s**-1
# (25) Comoving angular momentum of the simulation (y coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 gram * cm**2 * s**-1
# (26) Comoving angular momentum of the simulation (z coordinate). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 gram * cm**2 * s**-1
# (27) Sum of instantaneous accretion rate of all black holes in the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram * s**-1
#      Unit = 1.587043e+01 Msun/yr
# (28)  Total mass accreted by black holes in the simulation (not including mass accreted by progenitors that have merged in the current BHs). 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (29)  Total black hole subgrid mass in the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (30) Total Hydrogen (all species) mass in the gas phase of the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (31) Total Molecular Hydrogen mass in the gas phase of the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (32) Total Atomic Hydrogen mass in the gas phase of the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (33) Total Helium (all species) mass in the gas phase of the simulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+27 gram
#      Unit = 5.029144e-07 Msun
# (34) Total Magnetic Energy B2/(2*mu0) in thesimulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg
# (35) Total DivB error in thesimulation. 
#      Unit = dimensionless
# (36) Total Cross Helicity :: sum(V.B) in thesimulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+54 gram * cm * s**-3 * A**-1 
# (37) Total Magnetic Helicity :: sum(A.B) in thesimulation. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e-62 gram**2 * cm * s**-4 * A**-2
# (38) Total bolometric luminosity of the BHs. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg * s**-1
# (39) Total jet power of the BHs. 
#      Unit = 1.000000e+43 erg * s**-1
#
